Current source/fhir.ini has no active bbsnp, dbsnp, valueset-dbsnp, valueset-bbsnp, or observation-genetics-profile entry; the remaining current non-history dbSNP hit checked was tools/tx/v3/valuesets.ini:147, already spelled dbSNP and not the erroneous old FHIR value set id.
